items.t: In Pemberton, North Vancouver, houses sold at a median of $1,840,000 across 8 sales, and the middle half closed between $1,613,750 and $2,167,500. The median house sat 24 days and sold for 97.8% of list.
Pemberton, North Vancouver: 19 townhomes sold at a median of $1,450,000, with the middle half between $1,128,000 and $1,535,000. The median townhome took 14 days to sell and closed at 97.7% of list.

67 condos sold in Pemberton, North Vancouver at a median of $542,000 (middle half $462,500 to $766,250). A typical condo in Pemberton, North Vancouver spent 27 days on the market and closed at 96.6% of the asking price.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Pemberton compares with the rest of North Vancouver

items.t: Houses in Pemberton have the 21th highest median of 27 North Vancouver sub-areas, $1,840,000. Norgate is lowest at $1,516,500 and Forest Hills NV highest at $2,600,000. Lower Lonsdale ($1,815,000) sits just below and Lynn Valley ($1,845,000) sits just above.

Of 14 North Vancouver sub-areas with 5 or more townhome sales, Pemberton ranks 5th highest at $1,450,000; the range is $1,105,000 (Mosquito Creek) to $1,707,000 (Edgemont). Roche Point ($1,375,000) sits just below and Queensbury ($1,450,000) sits just above.
Condos in Pemberton have the lowest median of the 12 North Vancouver sub-areas, $542,000, below Lynnmour at $699,500; the highest is Northlands at $980,000.
